text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Satono 
Diamond—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh? Oh my, oh my, oh my!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, look what I found! There's a 
"side road" over there!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Waah~ I didn't even notice! That path over 
there... I wonder what it's like!

Before I could stop her, Satono Diamond 
darted down a side street...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, what a suspicious-looking place. 
It wouldn't be surprising if ghosts showed 
up...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... like this ghost-y 
monster?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, Jordan-san. Good evening♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, not surprised even a tiny bit? For 
real? Now I'm the one who feels 
embarrassed!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, what are you doing in a place like 
this?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I wondered what was at the end of this 
side path... so I'm on a little adventure 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The scenery feels so out of the ordinary, 
like a whole different world... Fufu, I 
just can't contain my excitement♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I see~. Wanna come along with me, then? I 
can show you somewhere fun!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...So anyway, the dog at this house is 
crazy! Like, the second you make eye 
contact, it starts barking at ya!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
What an energetic doggie! What kind of pup 
is it, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Big Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof woof! Bark!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wah, you're right! Hehe, that's so cute~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you're having fun~! Want to 
check out some other hype shops too?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Well, that sounds like fun—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Oh? That street over there looks 
especially dark.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on! That part's off-limits!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ no~... Like a hangout spot for 
bad-girl types?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's not like anything actually happened 
to me, but... there's no reason to go 
jumping into danger, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, Satono-chan, take this path 
instead of that one—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Are you for reaaaal?! Wait, Satono-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, could you be a delinquent rebel...? 
The kind I've seen in television dramas, 
um...

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Lady
text_block_list.text: Huh? What did you say?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my name is Satono Diamond. There is 
something I would really love to ask you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of delinquents, I've always been 
fond of the trope where they pick up a 
stray puppy in the rain... Have you ever 
done something like that yourself?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait, wait! Stop, stop!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"No, seriously, our bad! We'll get moving 
right away~!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah, but...!
choice_data_list:
I should apologize for talking to her so 
suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: D-Did you figure it out?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, then. Have a lovely day♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Delinquent-san... If only we could 
have spoken a bit more... What a pity.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait, weren't you scared!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't scared at all, you know? From 
what I saw in the drama, he's a kind soul 
who picks up abandoned puppies♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Satono-chan, that's insane~!

Satono Diamond looked so lonely that I 
decided not to scold her too harshly.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I suppose that was rather rude of me... My 
deepest apologies.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Lady
text_block_list.text:
"Tch. I don't feel like messing with 
anyone who isn't a delinquent anyway. 
Watch yourself next time."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! It's true what they 
say—you really are a tough, principled 
delinquent!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You know what's up, young lady. Heheh, 
wanna go hit up a teahouse or somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: My, are you sure? I'd love to join you♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real? Isn't Satono-chan way too 
strong!?

Afterward, Satono Diamond's eyes sparkled 
as she listened to the story of the 
delinquent girl.
